rationale: Law review article examining reparations, reconciliation and justice for American Indians in the American Indian Law Review. Clearly out of scope (wrong topic, E01) with no relation to household or community water or sanitation service access or outcomes.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Under the plain wording of Criterion 2, this law review article addresses legal/institutional issues (reparations and reconciliation in American Indian law), whereas under the narrow reading it does not examine a rule-type mechanism governing water or sanitation service access. Both readings yield exclusion (E01) because the record clearly fails Criterion 1 and Criterion 4 (non-water/sanitation topic).
